appDescription: Records proof of abnormal cabin noises: it keeps a short audio and vehicle-signal buffer while tracking and saves it when the driver says a noise just happened.

function.name: MARK_NOISE
function.description: Save the last 30 seconds and the next 10 seconds of cabin audio and vehicle signals because the driver just heard the registered noise.

location.description: Where in the cabin the driver heard the noise, in the driver's words.

function.name: START_TRACKING
function.description: Start keeping the rolling audio and vehicle-signal buffer for the registered noise symptom on this drive.

function.name: TRACKING_STATUS
function.description: Tell the driver how many noises were saved on this drive and in total for the open symptom.
